items.reviewNote: After les avoir plaints the dwarf pities their apparent weakness; this is transitive pity, not reflexive complain. The published compassion sense and earlier complaining plan were compared. Plural participial agreement follows les, while the same pity meaning remains shared.

The indirect questions ask about their past, activities, happiness, reproduction and soul. The existing exact candidate bank asks for an object/permission; the global family also has the distinct ask-information sense. Link that sense with its own demanda bank, without confusing asking questions with demanding a thing.

Sa tête eût été au-dessus locates the head spatially in the counterfactual. The other été use describes their misérable état and retains the copular identity; the passive and summer banks are excluded. Use the published presence sense for this participial form, preserving earlier spatial été dependency reconciliation.

The dwarf pities the humans’ tiny condition close to nonexistence. The global family includes reduced-to-misery/pity as well as a meagre monetary-value sense. Pitiable condition uses the former; new questions avoid limiting the source to poverty or an inadequate salary.

Voisin de marks figurative proximity to nonexistence, the same nearby meaning as the earlier voisine adjective. The published voisin family is a noun for a neighboring person; it cannot own the adjective directly. Reuse the earlier planned adjective meaning only after its noun-lemma target is corrected to a proper French adjective lemma during whole-work reconciliation; this explicit dependency prevents silent noun/adjective ownership mismatch.

The humans’ smallness is compared to being almost nothing; the narrator does not report their actual destruction. Anéantissement/agrandissement/éloignement/apaisement are masculine singular and all vowel-initial under unchanged l’. Reduction to nothing alone selects the noun.

items.meaning: belong to; be the property of
items.reviewNote: The apparent globe ownership by whales is a giant’s impression, not membership in a social group. The global appartenir family explicitly includes property; all four verbs fit leur in the unchanged infinitive construction. Keep the existing ownership sense and do not infer literal legal rights of whales.

S’ils étaient heureux asks about the people’s experienced happiness. The exact published favorable-event bank differs; the global family has a direct emotional happiness sense. Route this surface to that existing sense, with all four plural emotional predicates grammatical after ils sont.

The old source asks s’ils multipliaient without the modern reflexive se. In the sequence about living creatures this means propagation/increasing number, not arithmetic multiplication. The question explicitly paraphrases the modern reflexive construction while retaining the actual source target; no extra se occurrence is invented.

The reasoner belongs to the gathered shipboard company. The published troupe definition covers an organized group; its current bank is only theatrical and the earlier V proposal is military. Preserve the broad group sense and add an expedition context rather than invent a third subgroup sense. Troupe/famille/ménagerie/fratrie are feminine singular with une; expedition company selects troupe.

The reasoner resents the doubt cast on his soul. The earlier V choquer offend/affront plan has the same emotional offense meaning; no physical collision is inferred. Add the participial surface and its complete bank on that planned verb sense.

The giant questions the existence of a soul. The earlier douter uncertainty plan fits and is reused, not a newly invented past-tense sense. All four predicates take de in the unchanged construction; uncertainty rather than certainty, memory or joy selects doutait.

The reasoner observes the dwarf with a sighting instrument. No published or earlier observer family exists; it is attentive visual examination, not obedience to a rule. All four verbs fit the elided direct object l’ and distinguish attention from ignoring, avoidance and forgetting.

The observed interlocutor is the dwarf addressed in the measurement discussion. Interlocuteur/spectateur/messager/dormeur are masculine singular and fit son; the active reciprocal exchange, not merely being present or carrying a message, selects interlocuteur.

items.meaning: sighting vanes; pierced plates used for aiming
items.reviewNote: Académie’s pinnule entry defines pierced instrument plates used for surveying sight-lines. The source explicitly sets them on a quart de cercle. Pinnules/lentilles/graduations/aiguilles are feminine plural and fit les; pierced sighting plates select pinnules. No optical magnification, modern fern meaning or actual telescope is inferred.

The sighting vanes are aimed for observing the interlocutor, not threatening him with a firearm. All four participles match feminine plural pinnules in the unchanged stem. Direction for sighting alone selects braquées; earlier/published braquer families do not exist.

items.meaning: stations; positions occupied for taking observations
items.reviewNote: Académie 1762 station covers a temporary stop in a place. The source sighting instrument and sequential two/third positions establish the surveying function by contextual inference. Stations/équations/dimensions/graduations are feminine plural and fit ses; locations occupied by the observer alone select stations. No railway station is introduced.

À la troisième elides station, feminine singular, after two stations. All four ordinal choices are feminine singular; source order after first and second selects troisième. No distinct noun lemma is created merely because the noun is omitted.

Both parla ainsi occurrences introduce direct speech by the reasoner and Micromégas. The existing speak/treat-a-subject sense and earlier same-family proposals were checked. Add this past-historic surface without treating tense or the archaic parler spelling as a new meaning.

items.meaning: from; starting at a spatial point
items.reviewNote: Depuis la tête jusqu’aux pieds is a spatial extent, not a continuing time interval and not the earlier afterward adverb. The global depuis temporal definition and banks were reviewed; prepare a spatial-from sense on the existing preposition lemma while preserving both temporal meanings.

Ne se trompe pas denies a measuring error; the old exact trompe noun means a horn, and global tromper means deliberate deception. Neither is the reflexive be-mistaken function. Author this sense on the French tromper verb lemma, preserve both older families and all their mastery, and keep the complete source negation.

Quoi ! is an isolated incredulous exclamation before the assertion, not a question requesting an object. The only global quoi lemma is interrogative pronoun and all its banks ask for a thing. Prepare the exclamative function with explicit lexical-category reconciliation; do not silently attach a different lemma’s sense or transfer interrogative mastery.

Both m’a mesuré and je vous ai mesuré refer to the dwarf’s height. No global/earlier mesurer lemma exists. The singular participle agrees with the preposed direct object, while the later future form shares this dimensions-measurement meaning, not estimation of body mass.

Ma grandeur and grandeur apparente concern bodily dimensions visible to the observers. The earlier astronomical magnitude bank classifies stars by brightness, not size; it is excluded. Prepare a physical-size sense under its planned grandeur lemma. Grandeur/vitesse/masse/couleur are feminine singular and fit sa; body dimension alone selects grandeur.

items.meaning: his; his own, referring to his height
items.reviewNote: La sienne resumes la grandeur of the measured companion. The earlier siens plan substantivizes a person’s group; this feminine singular possessive resumes an inanimate attribute. Prepare this ordinary possessive-reference sense on a proper possessive-pronoun lemma, reconciled with the earlier sien family rather than the people-group noun interpretation.

The reasoner uses instruments and geometry to study the giants; historical physicien is a student of natural phenomena, not an English physician. Physicien/médecin/matelot/aumônier are masculine singular and fit un. The scientific-natural role selects physicien without asserting a modern disciplinary specialization.

items.meaning: will measure; determine the dimensions of
items.reviewNote: The physicist offers to measure the larger companion after measuring the dwarf. This future surface shares the current package’s measured-dimensions sense and lemma. Tense alone is not a new sense; the measurement concerns height, not mass, painting or relocation.

The companion and tree are physically large. The broad published grand sense includes considerable extent, and VI package 02 grande already augments that same meaning for size. Add this masculine singular contextual bank on the existing identity, without creating a size-only duplicate; grand respect retains the intensity bank and l’infiniment grand retains the full phrase.

The proposal is to measure the companion; it is accepted as a plan, not proved as a theorem or asserted as a fact. Earlier proposition assertion/theorem plans were read and excluded; prepare a proposal sense on their reconciled common proposition lemma. Proposition/démonstration/affirmation/interdiction are feminine singular after une.

The proposed measurement receives assent. Acceptée is a lexical passive participle, while fut is the separately reviewed passive auxiliary; the source does not say the proposal was physically received as an object. All four feminine singular participles fit elle fut.

The giant lies down for measurement because standing would put his head above clouds. The published lie-down sense and earlier couchée/couchèrent plans apply; the sleep/lodge sense does not. None of the questions asserts he falls asleep.

items.meaning: had; auxiliary in a hypothetical compound past
items.reviewNote: Se fût tenu debout is a compound form of reflexive se tenir, equivalent in the conditional hypothesis to had stood. It is neither a passive nor a simple copular fût exact. The global être auxiliary senses were inspected; add this accented surface to the existing compound-auxiliary meaning.

items.meaning: held himself; remained in a posture
items.reviewNote: Se tenir debout maintains bodily posture, not holding an object, inheriting a quality, addressing someone or considering something to be true. All global tenir senses were read; prepare posture under the existing lemma. The whole compound fût is separately an être auxiliary, not part of the lexical tenir meaning.

The source hypothesizes the giant standing rather than lying down. No published/earlier debout family exists. All alternatives complete il est as posture predicates, so standing on the feet—not a grammatical category difference—selects debout.

The head would be physically above the clouds; this is not moral superiority or beyond a numerical limit. The source uses au-dessus des and the bank retains that spatial reference. Middle alternatives all fit their stated complements; the above-height clue selects the target.

The clouds mark the hypothetical head’s height in the sky. The global physical-cloud and figurative-enveloping-state senses were inspected; choose atmospheric clouds. Nuages/monts/rochers/arbres are masculine plural and fit des, with suspended droplets selecting nuages.

The tree is set in the giant’s body as a triangulation marker; the narrator leaves the precise anatomical spot unnamed. Planter here fixes something upright rather than asserting agricultural growth or roots taking hold. All four direct-object verbs fit le; upright anchoring selects plantèrent.

Le docteur Swift uses an academic learned title, not a treating physician in this scene. Docteur/matelot/capitaine/messager are masculine singular and fit un; a doctoral title uniquely selects docteur. No specific degree institution or medical practice is invented.

items.meaning: would name; would call by its name
items.reviewNote: Swift would name the anatomical place that this narrator declines to name. The existing nommer definition includes designating something by a name, not just assigning a new name; reuse it. All four conditional predicates fit le, with designation rather than concealment, memory loss or avoidance selecting nommerait.

items.meaning: call; name; designate by a name
items.reviewNote: Appeler par son nom names the body location, rather than summoning a person to come. The global naming senses and earlier appelait naming plan were read; target the existing name sense. All four infinitives begin with vowels and fit unchanged l’; naming alone selects appeler.

Une suite de triangles is a connected sequence in a geometric construction, not a monarch’s entourage, a result or a continuation of a narrative. Suite/conséquence/compagnie/fin are feminine singular and fit une; successive linked elements select suite.

The philosophers use linked geometric triangles for the measurement. Triangles/cercles/carrés/rectangles are masculine plural after des; exactly three sides selects triangles. No measurement outcome is inferred from a token match.

The triangles connect in a geometric chain, not a friendship or lier conversation. The earlier planned lier lemma and relational-bond sense were read; prepare connected-elements meaning on that lemma, preserving the friendship sense and the phrase identity. All alternatives are masculine plural participles; connecting rather than separating/erasing/hiding selects liés.

Their linked-triangle computation produces an inferred height. The published conclude sense and earlier concluez plan apply, not merely ending a meeting. The independent retrieval clue tests deriving a conclusion, with no claim that automated source checks prove the measurement.

Micromégas utters the observation about apparent size. No earlier/published prononcer family exists; the source says words aloud, not judicially passing a sentence. All four singular past predicates fit les; aloud articulation selects prononça.

The apparent grandeur is the observable physical scale, a potentially misleading basis for judging worth. The feminine adjective agrees with grandeur and all four alternatives are feminine singular. No fake or nonexistent height is asserted; only the inference from size to intelligence is cautioned against in the source.

Paraissent si méprisables describes the deceptive impression caused by small size; the following prayer acknowledges their intelligence. Do not endorse the narrator’s seeming lack of worth as an actual fact. No global or earlier méprisable family exists; the plural adjective agrees with substances.

The deity creates the infinitely small as easily as the infinitely large; aussi peu concerns the effort of creation, not a purchase price. The sole published coûter sense is explicitly monetary. Prepare effort under that existing verb lemma, retaining price mastery; the bank contrasts effort required with benefit, pleasure or displeasure.

items.meaning: these ones; the beings just referred to
items.reviewNote: Ceux-ci resumes the tiny beings just addressed, in the possibility of still smaller beings. The Chapter I celui-ci demonstrative plan is the same near-reference sense and proper pronoun lemma. Add this plural surface without creating a number-only sense or using the unrelated celui pronominal identity.

Esprit supérieur concerns intellectual capability or merit, not location or institutional rank. The only published sense defines physical placement or higher rank. Prepare qualitative superiority under the existing adjective lemma; size does not establish intellectual superiority in this passage.

Superbes qualifies the magnificent cosmic animals. The global admirable-beautiful sense covers their impressive appearance; no arrogance is reported. There is no exact plural candidate bank, so add the plural surface and three contextual bands on the existing sense, with no new plural-only meaning.

items.meaning: foot; bodily extremity at the end of a leg
items.reviewNote: The imagined animal’s foot is an anatomical extremity, not the old length unit. The published definition is restricted to human feet. This contextual augmentation is an explicit dependency: before activation, impact-review the shared pied family and broaden the definition to human and animal anatomy while preserving unchanged human mastery. Do not silently approve the current human-only wording or invent an animal-only duplicate. Pied/genou/coude/poignet are masculine singular after son.

The enormous foot would overlie the globe by its physical extent. The global generic covered-by-something sense applies to physical covering, unlike material coating, hiding a fault or figurative defamation. Add this conditional surface on the generic physical cover sense; final family reconciliation must normalize its participial gloss without resetting existing physical-cover mastery.

items.meaning: have; auxiliary forming a compound past
items.reviewNote: Je suis descendu forms a compound past of intransitive descent. The exact suis candidate is copular; the global être family has the proper compound auxiliary sense. Add the inflected bank to that shared auxiliary identity, while descendu carries the lexical downward motion.

Micromégas recalls descending onto this globe. The global go-down sense and Chapter V descendent routing match, rather than carrying something down or genealogical descent. The first-person masculine singular participle gets its own surface bank on the existing downward-motion sense.

items.meaning: intelligent; able to understand and reason
items.reviewNote: Intelligents describes beings smaller than humans as capable of understanding. The published intelligence noun does not own an adjective sense; no existing adjective or earlier plan was found. Prepare the proper French adjective lemma with three bands; the passage does not assign a modern intelligence score.

items.meaning: much; to a considerably greater degree
items.reviewNote: Beaucoup plus petits intensifies comparative degree, rather than counting numerous beings or a large amount of matter. The published beaucoup definition and all three quantity banks were read. Prepare comparative intensification under the same adverb lemma, retaining the earlier quantity identity; all four adverbs fit plus petits.

Non pas excludes the fabulous Virgil account before mais introduces observed anatomy. The published definition includes negation/exclusion, but its banks ask oral refusal. Add an exclusion-context bank on that same sense rather than approving the refusal bank as a source fit or importing an earlier ou non phrase.

items.meaning: fabulous; based on fable or imagination
items.reviewNote: Fabuleux qualifies the imagined bee accounts attributed to Virgil, contrasted with observations/dissection. It does not mean the modern praise wonderful or extraordinary. No published or earlier family exists; prepare the fable-based sense without judging every statement by Virgil.

All three abeilles uses concern the insects in observed anatomy and relative-size comparisons. Abeilles/guêpes/fourmis/mouches are feminine plural and fit les; honey-making and nectar gathering select bees. Do not infer an exact species or approve the fabulous accounts as zoological fact.

items.meaning: dissected; cut open for anatomical study
items.reviewNote: The Réaumur reference describes anatomical dissection, matching Chapter I disséqua’s planned dissect meaning and verb lemma. This participial form does not create a tense-only meaning. No specific experiment or date is invented; the bank tests opening for anatomical study.

The cosmic animals have great physical extent, the same broad large/spacious sense as the earlier VI vaste funnel bank. Add the plural adjective form on that shared planned meaning, without an animal-only sense. All four plural descriptors fit the stem; considerable extent selects vastes.

Devant lesquelles in the repeated scale analogy means in comparison with those substances, not their literal spatial front. Académie 9 devant I.4 explicitly includes relative comparison, supporting this contextual reading. The global definition/bank is spatial position or actual presence; prepare comparison under that existing preposition lemma, preserving earlier spatial mastery.

The conversation gradually becomes engaging as each side learns about relative scales of intelligent life. Intéressante is a feminine singular adjective agreeing with conversation; all four choices match that agreement. No existing/earlier intéressant family exists, and no personal financial interest is inferred.
